title: Unvisited variables are preserved
statement: Let a finite-domain constraint satisfaction problem have a nonempty multiset of constraints, with every declared variable occurring in some constraint scope. Suppose the domain is nonempty and the variable set has decidable equality. After running the local conditional steps through a list from an initial state, any variable absent from the list has both its law and its assigned label unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: The domain is finite and nonempty
The variable set has decidable equality
Every declared variable occurs in a constraint scope
A list of variables and an initial state
The specified variable is absent from the list
